notes: This is planning input, not evidence. Disconnect has a real catalog entry and passed raw JUnit sidecar evidence; it now awaits protected review. Resign membership and a bounded resign-action ownership/object-disposition slice—including final-federate directive-2 handling and continuation of assumption search after later eligibility—getTimeFactory, federate lookup, object-class lookup, interaction-class lookup, inherited-attribute lookup, inherited-parameter lookup, dimension lookup/upper-bound services, interaction declaration state, ordinary and regional declaration relevance advisories and their per-federate switches, bounded receive-order directed-interaction declaration/delivery, object-class attribute declaration state, unnamed object-instance registration/discovery and known-instance lookups, bounded regional object registration/association/subscription and overlap-filtered no-time reflection, limited receive-order Send Interaction/Receive Interaction, Update Attribute Values/Reflect Attribute Values, object-instance/object-class Request Attribute Value Update/Provide Attribute Value Update delivery, bounded 2025 ownership acquisition/divestiture transitions and callbacks, the mandatory transportation-type lookup pair, federation-list/report callbacks, initial time-role control, no-TSO Query GALT/Query LITS, and limited no-TSO GALT/NRG TAR scheduling have real Catch2 coverage in Umbra's non-installable embedded development profile, but they have no catalog record, JUnit sidecar, protected review, production package, or conformance claim.

tests.next_action: This private validator regression distinguishes an existing directory from a missing FOM designator and preserves the source_unreadable diagnostic boundary. tests.test_case: The official 2025 DIF schema rejects duplicate attribute and parameter names within one class
tests.next_action: This native validator regression exercises the official 2025 DIF XSD xs:unique constraints for direct object-class attributes and interaction-class parameters. The rule remains owned by the vendored standard schema rather than a parallel Umbra semantic check; equivalent declarations across separate module documents remain an Annex C composition concern. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service claim.

It does not claim complete FOM/SOM conformance, full table semantics, JUnit/protected review, packaging, or public-service evidence.

Omitted values remain representable for incomplete DIF modules. It does not claim complete object-model identification, FOM/SOM conformance, JUnit/protected review, packaging, or public-service evidence.

The official MIM+Restaurant artifact remains a separate negative because its DIF source includes an incomplete custom basic-data row and the RL-009 representation/schema/example tension; this lane is not a public RTI service, JUnit/protected-review, or conformance claim.

It does not claim full data-type merge semantics, dependency packaging, JUnit/protected review, or conformance.

tests.test_case: The FOM composition preflight resolves representations and special instance identifiers
tests.next_action: This private composition slice rejects unresolved simple/enumerated representations and invalid ordinary reference representations, while applying the reviewed HLAobjectInstanceName/HLAobjectInstanceHandle exception.
